spans.s:
mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be used or enjoyed.
2 To be eaten.
E.
भुज to eat, &c., तव्य aff.

mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ)
1 Enjoying, an enjoyer.
2 An eater.
m. (-क्ता)
A husband.
E.
भुज to enjoy, &c., aff. तृच्.

n. (-त्वं)
Possession, enjoyment.
E.
त्व added to the last.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being about to eat.
E.
भुज to eat, and शानच् aff., here of the future tense.
